title: Homemade Cheez-Its Recipe (2 Ingredients)
summary: I make these homemade Cheez-Its by cutting ultra-thin deli cheese into squares, poking a hole in each one, and baking them low and slow until crisp. No flour, no oil, healthy, and super easy to make.
ingredients: 6 slices ultra-thin sliced deli cheese (I use cheddar)
steps: Preheat the oven to 275°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut each cheese slice into 4 smaller squares. Place them on the baking sheet about ¾ inch apart.
Once the sheet is full, use a straw to cut a hole in the center of each square.
Remove the pan from the oven and sprinkle the crackers with salt. Gently blot them with paper towels to remove some of the grease.
Let the crackers cool on the pan before removing them.
